title: Oil Tops $110 for First Time Since May as Supply Risk Grows
summary: Brent oil hit $110 a barrel for the first time since May as prospects for imminent supply relief dwindle, prompting traders to ramp up bullish bets ahead of the weekend.

title: Trump Says He Didn’t Order Ukraine Starshield Access Limits
summary:
Melinda Haring, nonresident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, said that Ukraine running out of Patriot missiles and the outage of the country's Starshield were 'tremendously damaging' for frontline defenses in the war with Russia. 
Haring also discussed the relationship between Ukraine and the US, saying that despite Trump's recent Russian diesel deal and his comments about Ukraine's leadership, Americans support Ukraine and are 'ashamed of what’s happening in Washington.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Paschi Top 10 Investor Goldstone Backs Intesa Takeover Bid
summary: Goldstone Capital Limited, a shareholder in Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA backed by Qatari investors, said it supports Intesa Sanpaolo SpA’s takeover bid for the Tuscan lender, emerging as the latest investor to support the deal.

title: US Bonds Fall as Treasury Is Silent on Long End, Oil Climbs
summary: Treasuries declined as predictions fell flat that US government officials would directly nod at the possibility of reducing its sales of long-term debt and as oil prices rose.

title: Metals Rebound as Sentiment Improves After Volatile Week
summary: Metals — including copper, aluminum and zinc — rebounded after hotter-than-expected US inflation and a selloff in AI stocks rattled markets this week.

title: Morocco’s Football Boss Named Finance Minister With Broader Role
summary: Morocco appointed the head of its football federation as finance minister, as the 2030 FIFA World Cup co-host faces the challenge of narrowing fiscal leeway and pressing demand for social spending.

title: Stocks Fall on Renewed AI Jitters as Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
summary: Another burst of selling in technology companies rattled Wall Street, dragging down stocks as investors questioned the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade.

title: ¿Por qué el frenesí de deuda por la IA inquieta a los mercados?
summary: Los CDS de Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta y Amazon se han disparado desde 2025. Wall Street empieza a preguntarse si el auge de la IA justificará la enorme deuda acumulada.

title: Mortgage Bond Sales Put on Hold as Investors Demand More Yield
summary: A growing list of mortgage lenders is holding off on offerings of bonds backed by home and commercial-property loans as investors demand more compensation to take on the risk amid growing turbulence in rates markets.

title: Bank of America Set to Raise $8 Billion in High-Grade Bond Deal
summary: Bank of America Corp. is poised to raise $8 billion through an unusual Friday high-grade bond offering, braving the market after a turbulent week in credit markets disrupted fundraising plans for numerous borrowers.

title: S&P 500 Slides as Chipmakers Extend Slump on Growing AI Worries
summary: The S&P 500 Index declined on Friday and was on track for its worst week since June as worries about the viability of the artificial intelligence trade weighed on chipmakers.

title: Oaktree’s Deal to Buy A-Cap Insurer Crumbles, Spawning New Talks
summary: Oaktree Capital Management’s agreement to take over a life insurer owned by Advantage Capital Holdings has collapsed, leaving the companies to discuss alternatives after regulators raised alarms over the business’s potential exposure to defunct investment firm 777 Partners.

title: Big US Bank Stocks Eye Worst Weekly Losing Streak Since 2008
summary: Big US bank shares are set to record their worst weekly losing streak since the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, after quarterly earnings didn’t do enough to lift sentiment for the ailing sector.

title: Trump’s ‘Mother Of All Bombs’ Threat Unlikely to Hit Iran’s Buried Nuclear Sites
summary: President Donald Trump’s threat to use what’s known as the “Mother Of All Bombs” to hit Iran might be effective at hitting some military targets but would do little to destroy nuclear facilities buried deep under a mountain.

title: Cockroach Party Leader Detained Before Delhi Protest
summary: Indian authorities detained Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party, on Friday as thousands of demonstrators took to the streets of New Delhi over a contentious voter-roll revision and the arrest of two prominent party leaders. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Brazil Judge Orders Meta to Treat Runoff Candidates Equally
summary: A Brazilian electoral court judge ordered Meta Platforms Inc. not to interfere with the distribution of political or election-related content from any candidate in the Oct. 25 runoff.

title: EU Carmakers Hail Deal on Emissions That Opens Door to the UK
summary: Europe’s auto industry welcomed a deal between France and Germany that provides relief for manufacturers grappling with high costs and intense Chinese competition.

title: Indian Police Detain ‘Cockroach’ Leader as Protests Spread
summary: Indian authorities detained the founder of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party, Abhijeet Dipke, on Friday in a bid to block a protest that drew thousands of demonstrators on the streets of New Delhi over a contentious voter-roll revision and the arrest of two prominent activists.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 16
summary: Oil edged higher on growing doubts about US President Donald Trump’s deal to release more Russian diesel into global markets amid supply disruptions from the Strait of Hormuz to the Black Sea.
